# markdown-it

`markdown-it.cjs` is the unmodified `dist/markdown-it.min.js` from
[markdown-it 14.3.2](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it/releases/tag/14.3.2),
renamed for Bun's CommonJS loader. SHA-256:
`e32488403e2e565ac12a9669bfdf2b1b876eb0a5c84f8e0699884b562d18eb52`.

The pinned distribution is checked in so tests and the browser build do not
need a package installation or network access. Its MIT license is in `LICENSE`
and is included in the generated userscript.
